_note: S334: the studio publishes eight live-data surfaces (/stats/, /stats/ecosystem/, /status/, /proof/, /studio-pulse/, /oracle/, /notebook/, /ignis-health/) that all answer versions of one question — 'is this studio real and working?' — with no front door. This file defines the spine. Each lane keeps its deep page as the canonical destination; the hub only routes and stamps freshness, so no receipt or permalink moves. `feed` must be a public, publicSafe JSON artifact carrying generatedAt; a lane whose feed cannot be read reports UNKNOWN rather than a stale green.

lanes.label: Live
lanes.question: Is everything up right now?
lanes.blurb: Real-time service status for the Vault, the games, and the edge in front of them.

lanes.label: Numbers
lanes.question: How big is any of this, actually?
lanes.blurb: Source-dated portfolio, audience, editorial and performance statistics — each figure carrying its own freshness, bots separated from people.

lanes.label: Proof
lanes.question: Can I check any of it myself?
lanes.blurb: This one does not ask for trust. It re-fetches the public deploy ledger and re-computes every hash in your own browser, on your machine, while you watch.

lanes.label: Motion
lanes.question: What is actually moving this week?
lanes.blurb: The forge in motion — every world under construction, the commit-level notebook, and the Oracle's live read of each project.
